Method of Attack: Android backdoor embedded in apps developed using Xamarin framework
Requests Accessibility Service permission to perform privileged actions
Communicates with C2 server to fetch second-stage payload
Executes commands to gather device info, geo info, emulator detection, root status, list installed packages, accessibility status, and fetch payload
Possible ad-fraud by automatically clicking ads and installing adware
Attack Vector: Malicious apps on Google Play and third-party app stores via APK files
Indicators of Compromise: Infected apps on Google Play including Essential Horoscope for Android, 3D Skin Editor for PE Minecraft, Logo Maker Pro, Auto Click Repeater, Count Easy Calorie Calculator, Dots: One Line Connector, Sound Volume Extender
Files named 'Core.dll' and 'GoogleService.dll' embedded in apps
